caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest positioned on a plain, light beige background. The chest is rectangular and rendered in shades of brown, representing the grain and natural color of wood. The chest has a flat lid with a slight overhang and features decorative elements on the front panel. These decorations consist of two pairs of vertical, turned wooden columns or spindles set between symmetrical, geometric panels with raised, angular shapes and rectangular recesses. The side of the chest is plain, showing the texture of the wood. The overall composition is centered, with the chest angled slightly so both the front and right side are visible. There are no other objects or details in the background.
title: Bible Box
